# PersonEmail

An email address on a person record, returned when $expand=emails is requested. Every email a person holds is returned; there is no best-email flag, and `isPreferred` is the only ranking among them.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | The email address. |
| `type` | string | What kind of address this is. `P` = personal, `W` = work, `O` = other. Defaults to `P` when not set at write time, so it is never null. One of: `P`, `W`, `O`. |
| `dateCreated` | string (date-time) | When the address was added to the person record. Set by the server. |
| `isPreferred` | boolean | Whether this is the person's preferred email address. Exactly one address per person carries it — normally the most recently added one, unless an address was pinned by an explicit write; see `PersonEmailInput.isPreferred`. The array comes back **preferred first, then the remaining addresses by `dateCreated` descending**. Addresses that share a `dateCreated` — it has only minute resolution — have no defined order among themselves. |
| `isSubscribed` | boolean or null | The pre-Targeted-Email view of `subscriptionStatus`: whether the address may be used in a broadcast email. Derived from `subscriptionStatus` — `S` maps to true, `U` to false, and `N` to null, since neutral has no boolean equivalent. |
| `subscriptionStatus` | string or null | Targeted Email subscription state. `S` = subscribed — the default at write time, and the only status that receives Targeted Email messages. `N` = neutral — no message, but not an opt-out. `U` = unsubscribed. Null on some addresses (`isSubscribed` is null there too). This property exists only where the Targeted Email feature is enabled. One of: `U`, `N`, `S`, `None`. |

`*` = required.
